title: The JASONs solve DoD problems in summer studies

tellings.quote: They're supposed to solve problems that the DoD gives to them.

plain: The JASONs are a group of top scientists who advise the US government, and their job is to work through problems that the Department of Defense hands them, in studies held over the summer. A Pentagon scientist named Eric W. Davis describes the group this way to Jesse Michels, saying plainly: "They're supposed to solve problems that the DoD gives to them." He brings it up to show how the military gets outside scientists to take on its hardest questions.
